en.description: Agromapa gives Slovak farmers and co-owners a hexagonal map of land quality, typical rent and fragmentation so they can negotiate fair lease agreements.

howItWorks.heading: From the map to a fair rental in four steps

steps.title: Open the map
steps.description: Navigate to your cadastral area on the hexagonal map and click any cell to reveal its quality score, typical rent and fragmentation data.

steps.title: Read the hex data
steps.description: Compare the BPEJ-based quality index and local rental benchmark for that cell against the figures in your own lease agreement.

steps.title: Log your parcels
steps.description: Sign in and add your land parcels with their current rental rates to build a personal register you can revisit and update any time.

steps.title: Reach out for help
steps.description: Contact us if you need support reading the data, understanding your rights, or preparing for a lease renegotiation.

items.question: Where does the land quality data come from?
items.answer: Quality scores are derived from publicly available BPEJ (soil-ecological unit) data published by Slovak authorities. The base map does not use cadastral transactional prices.

items.question: Is Agromapa a real estate trading platform?
items.answer: No. Agromapa is an information and analysis tool. It shows quality indices and rent benchmarks so you can make better-informed decisions — it does not broker sales or rentals.

items.question: Do I need to register to see the map?
items.answer: The public map is visible to everyone without signing in. Creating an account lets you log your own parcels, record rental rates and track them over time.

items.question: What is the fragmentation index?
items.answer: It is the average number of co-owners per hectare within a hexagonal cell. A high index signals highly fragmented ownership — common across Slovakia and directly relevant to lease negotiations.

items.question: Can I look up a specific cadastral parcel number?
items.answer: The current version shows aggregated data at hex level rather than individual parcel identifiers. You can log your own parcel details in the My Parcels section after signing in.

dashboard.title: My Parcels

listings.heading: Sample land zones on the map
listings.intro: These illustrative hexagonal zones show the kind of quality, rent and fragmentation data Agromapa carries for every cell across Slovakia.
listings.notice: These are illustrative example zones only — not real listings for sale or rent.

offer-1.title: Žitný ostrov arable zone
offer-1.summary: High-quality arable land in the Danubian lowland — hexagons with quality scores well above the national average and steady rental demand throughout the area.

offer-2.title: East Slovakia arable zone
offer-2.summary: Arable land in the Košice basin with moderate quality scores; a higher co-owner count makes consolidation conversations particularly worthwhile here.

offer-3.title: Orava highland grassland
offer-3.summary: Permanent grassland at higher elevation in the Orava region; below-average quality score but valued for livestock grazing and agri-environment payment eligibility.

offer-4.title: Záhorie vineyard zone
offer-4.summary: Premium vineyard land west of the Small Carpathians where BPEJ quality peaks and typical rent reflects the specialist nature of viticulture in the region.

offer-5.title: Nitra region arable zone
offer-5.summary: Productive arable land in the Nitra basin with above-average quality scores and an established, active rental market across the area.

contactForm.heading: Get in touch
contactForm.intro: Ask a question about the map, your land data or how to use Agromapa for your specific situation.

useCases.heading: Built for those without an analyst

items.title: The farmer checking rental fairness
items.situation: A small farmer has been renting out a 4-hectare arable plot at the same rate for eight years and wonders whether it still reflects the going market level.
items.action: They open the relevant hexagonal cell, compare the benchmark rent against their contract rate, and arrive at the renewal conversation with a concrete market-backed number.

items.title: The co-owner deciding after an inheritance
items.situation: A person inherits a co-ownership share in several scattered plots and has no idea what they are worth or how they are currently managed.
items.action: They map each plot's hex cell, read the quality score and fragmentation index, and decide whether to continue the existing lease, renegotiate, or explore consolidation.

items.title: The beginning farmer scouting new land
items.situation: A young farmer planning to expand production wants to understand going rental rates in a neighbouring cadastral area before approaching landowners.
items.action: They filter the map by arable land, read the typical rent for each hex in the target area, and approach owners with figures grounded in local market data.

landing.subheadline: Agromapa dáva malým farmárom a spoluvlastníkom prehľad o kvalite pôdy, trhovom nájomnom a rozdrobenosti — priamo na mape Slovenska.

features.title: Hexagónová mapa kvality
features.description: Prezrite si skóre kvality odvodené z BPEJ pre každú hexagónovú bunku na Slovensku — od celonárodného po detailný miestny pohľad.

features.title: Benchmark nájomného
features.description: Zistite typické nájomné pre vašu lokalitu v €/ha/rok a porovnajte ho so sumou, ktorú platíte alebo dostávate.

features.title: Index rozdrobenosti
features.description: Overte, koľko spoluvlastníkov zdieľa hektár v danej bunke — kľúčová metrika pre slovenský trh s pôdou.

features.title: Filter kultúr
features.description: Filtrujte mapu podľa ornej pôdy, trvalých trávnych porastov, viníc alebo sadov a zamerajte sa len na kultúru, ktorá vás zaujíma.

features.title: Evidencia mojich parciel
features.description: Zadajte vlastné parcely, zaznamenajte aktuálne nájomné a okamžite uvidíte, či je nad alebo pod miestnym benchmarkom.

howItWorks.heading: Od mapy k férovému nájmu v štyroch krokoch

steps.title: Otvorte mapu
steps.description: Prejdite na vaše katastrálne územie a kliknite na hexagónovú bunku — uvidíte skóre kvality, typické nájomné a index rozdrobenosti.

steps.title: Prečítajte si dáta bunky
steps.description: Porovnajte index kvality podľa BPEJ a miestny benchmark nájomného s číslami z vašej nájomnej zmluvy.

steps.title: Evidujte svoje parcely
steps.description: Prihláste sa a pridajte vlastné parcely s aktuálnym nájomným, aby ste si budovali osobný register, ku ktorému sa kedykoľvek vrátite.

steps.title: Kontaktujte nás
steps.description: Napíšte nám, ak potrebujete pomoc s čítaním dát, porozumením vašich práv alebo prípravou na rokovanie o nájomnom.

items.question: Odkiaľ pochádzajú dáta o kvalite pôdy?
items.answer: Skóre kvality sú odvodené z verejne dostupných dát BPEJ (bonitovaných pôdno-ekologických jednotiek) zverejnených slovenskými úradmi. Základná mapa nepoužíva katastrálne realizačné ceny.

items.question: Je Agromapa realitná platforma?
items.answer: Nie. Agromapa je informačný a analytický nástroj. Zobrazuje indexy kvality a benchmarky nájomného, aby ste mohli robiť lepšie informované rozhodnutia — nesprostredkúva predaj ani prenájom.

items.question: Musím sa registrovať, aby som videl mapu?
items.answer: Verejná mapa je prístupná každému bez prihlásenia. Po vytvorení účtu môžete evidovať vlastné parcely, zaznamenávať nájomné a sledovať jeho vývoj v čase.

items.question: Čo je index rozdrobenosti?
items.answer: Je to priemerný počet spoluvlastníkov na hektár v rámci hexagónovej bunky. Vysoký index naznačuje silne rozdrobenú vlastnícku štruktúru — na Slovensku bežnú situáciu, ktorá priamo ovplyvňuje dynamiku rokovaní o nájme.

items.question: Môžem vyhľadať konkrétne číslo katastrálnej parcely?
items.answer: Aktuálna verzia zobrazuje agregované dáta na úrovni hexagónu, nie jednotlivé čísla parciel. Vlastné parcely môžete evidovať v sekcii Moje parcely po prihlásení.

dashboard.title: Moje parcely
dashboard.intro: Evidujte všetky svoje parcely, sledujte nájomné a porovnávajte ho s miestnym benchmarkom priamo na mape.
